decision_rule: First-stage Q38P-3a: Qwen3.8-27B Q8_0, C=champion c72ec82f5 ROCm 6.2 vs B=same source ROCm 10.1 build-nolto-u600, spec off, np1 ctx 65536, 2 ABBA paired launches C B B C, five fixed greedy prompts each.
